---
title: "Profile Summary (AR)"
description: |
  Profile summary report generated from a single Parquet file has been created from 190 NetCDF files from the Arctic Ocean in situ NRT observations.
---

```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)
library(reportlib)
r_func_path <- "./_func"
r_funcs <- c("common_site.Rmd", "common_ar.Rmd")
```

```{r, import, child=file.path(r_func_path, r_funcs)}
```

```{r, location_filtering1, include = FALSE}
src <- knitr::knit_expand(template_path("location_filtering.Rmd"), df=df_name, df_filtered=df_filtered_name)
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE)
```

## 1. Basic Information
```{r, basic_info, results = 'asis'}
res <- knitr::knit_expand(template_path("summary_basic_info.Rmd"))
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```

---

## 2. Descriptive Statistics of `r region_code1` CTD Data
```{r, descriptive_stats, results = 'asis'}
src <- knitr::knit_expand(template_path("summary_descriptive_stats.Rmd"), df=df_filtered_name)
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```

## 3. Locations
```{r, locations, results = 'asis'}
src <- knitr::knit_expand(template_path("summary_locations.Rmd"), plot_height=5)

cat(res, sep = '\n')
```
